messages:
Lina: Quick follow-up from today's postmortem — eviction cascade during the big rollout. Need to assign owners and firm ETAs for 3 follow-ups: automatic cache warm, eviction thresholds, and CI gating for regressions.

Marco: I can pick up the cache warm automation. Suggest R=Marco, A=Lina, C=Sofia, I=Priya. ETA 10 days.

Sofia: I'll take the eviction thresholds tuning with a small canary. R=Sofia, A=Lina, C=Marco, I=Oncall Bot. ETA 1 week.

Priya (QA): I'll own CI gating and the regression harness. ETA: PR with tests by Tue next week. Will need a short acceptance checklist.

Lina: Thanks. I've created tickets and linked to PM-2478: RM-4010 (cache-warm job + rollout), RM-4011 (threshold tuning + canary), RM-4012 (regression suite + CI gate).

Oncall Bot: Created Jira issues RM-4010, RM-4011, RM-4012 and linked to PM-2478.

Marco: RM-4010 assigned to Marco. I'll include a prototype script and a rollout plan that warms hot shards before traffic spikes.

Sofia: RM-4011 assigned to Sofia. Will schedule a 1-hour canary window and add metrics to the dashboard for eviction rate, KV hit-rate, and tail latency.

Priya (QA): RM-4012 assigned to Priya. I'll add deterministic repros and a flaky-test checklist. Also want a gating rule: tests must pass on staging for 24h before merges.

Lina: Proposal for ticket aging automation to prevent stale actions:

```
Jira automation:
when: issue created
if: status not in (Done, Cancelled) and days since created >= 4
then: add comment "Action item stale: owner please update ETA or escalate"; set label "needs-owner-review"; ping #postmortems
```

Marco: Ack, will add a note in RM-4010 linking to the automation.

Sofia: Can we also add a recurring incident-pattern note to the PM so we capture the ~3-week cadence? Might be useful for prioritization.

Priya (QA): Agree — I'll add a test to the regression harness that simulates repeated small bursts to catch pattern regressions.

Lina: Hand-off plan for first 3 weeks: week1 primary oncall = Marco (cache warming ops), week2 primary = Sofia (threshold ops), week3 fallback = Lina. Please update your Jira tickets with owner, ETA, and acceptance criteria by EOD tomorrow. If anyone needs more time, flag in the ticket and we'll reassign. :white_check_mark:
